test.create_query: CREATE TABLE test_pk ( `dt` DateTime, `key` String ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (dt, key) SETTINGS index_granularity = 4;

CREATE TABLE test_pk_long ( `dt` DateTime, `key` String, `pad` String ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (dt, key, pad || 'a', pad || 'b', pad || 'c', pad || 'd', pad || 'e', pad || 'f', pad || 'g', pad || 'h', pad || 'i', pad || 'j', pad || 'k', pad || 'l', pad || 'm', pad || 'n', pad || 'o', pad || 'p', pad || 'q', pad || 'r', pad || 's', pad || 't') SETTINGS index_granularity = 4;

CREATE TABLE test_pk_long_back ( `dt` DateTime, `key` String, `pad` String ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (dt, pad || 'a', pad || 'b', pad || 'c', pad || 'd', pad || 'e', pad || 'f', pad || 'g', pad || 'h', pad || 'i', pad || 'j', pad || 'k', pad || 'l', pad || 'm', pad || 'n', pad || 'o', pad || 'p', pad || 'q', pad || 'r', pad || 's', pad || 't', key) SETTINGS index_granularity = 4;
INSERT INTO test_pk SELECT toDateTime('2001-01-01') + number, number % 16 FROM numbers_mt(1000000);
INSERT INTO test_pk_long SELECT toDateTime('2001-01-01') + number, number % 16, number % 16 FROM numbers_mt(1000000);
INSERT INTO test_pk_long_back SELECT toDateTime('2001-01-01') + number, number % 16, number % 16 FROM numbers_mt(1000000);
test.query: SELECT toDate(dt) AS dt, count() FROM test_pk WHERE (dt >= '2001-01-02') AND (dt <= '2001-01-11') AND (key = '1') GROUP BY dt ORDER BY dt ASC;
SELECT toDate(dt) AS dt, count() FROM test_pk_long WHERE (dt >= '2001-01-02') AND (dt <= '2001-01-11') AND (key = '1') GROUP BY dt ORDER BY dt ASC;
SELECT toDate(dt) AS dt, count() FROM test_pk_long_back WHERE (dt >= '2001-01-02') AND (dt <= '2001-01-11') AND (key = '1') GROUP BY dt ORDER BY dt ASC;
